title: [LOGGED OUT] Store footer social icons have names for screen readers
reason: None of the 6 footer social links has an accessible name

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded. The cookie banner was not yet visible in the screenshot (it appeared in the page a moment later).

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner was present, clicked Dismiss, banner gone
Footer visible with 6 social icons (YouTube, X, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook)

steps.text: Does each of the 6 social icon links have an accessible name (aria-label, title or text, for example "YouTube")?
steps.saw: All 6 links (youtube.com/@playludus, twitter.com/playludus, tiktok.com/@playludus, discord.gg, instagram.com/play.ludus.game, facebook.com/play.ludus) have no aria-label, no title, no text; the inner image has alt="".
